title: Only 15% Of Adults Can Pass This RAF Entrance Exam
summary: Explore Origins of the RAF, History and Identity, People and Purpose, Aircraft and Technology, The Historical Briefing across five six-question rounds.

landing.intro:
Explore a century of aviation.
How much do you remember?

about.body:
Five rounds offer different angles on this challenge: Origins of the RAF, History and Identity, People and Purpose, Aircraft and Technology, The Historical Briefing. Each round contains six distinct questions.

Choose one of four answers and move on automatically. There is no time limit. A short rewarded ad opens the quiz, each next round and the final result. The target is 24 correct answers out of 30. The result describes this quiz attempt only.

For entertainment and general learning only. This is not an official RAF recruitment test, eligibility check or assessment.

steps: Press Start, watch a short rewarded ad and begin.
Choose one answer per question and progress through five rounds.
Complete all 30 questions to reveal your result. You can then unlock the full breakdown.
